relationships.subject: JST-653
relationships.evidence_quote: the administration of JST-653 effectively attenuated mechanical hyperalgesia in the HSV-inoculated mice

relationships.subject: TRPV1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPV1 contributes to this pain because it is expressed on dural nerve fibers of trigeminal origin in humans, which releases calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP)

relationships.subject: TRPV1 antagonists
relationships.evidence_quote: adverse effects on body temperature (Tb), primarily hyperthermia, were repeatedly observed

relationships.subject: TRPA1
relationships.evidence_quote: TRPA1 is one of the primary transducers linked to the CGRP release, causing local inflammation, neuronal sensitization, and, therefore, pain

key_findings: TRPV1-targeting ligands show antinociception in orofacial pain models and trials but cause hyperthermia
TRPV1 contributes to dental, TMJ, trigeminal neuropathic, cancer and migraine-related orofacial pain
